topic: Simple Circuits and Conductivity of Materials
key_concepts: A closed circuit has a complete path that allows electric charge to flow
An open circuit has a break in the path so charge cannot move
Electric current flows only in a closed circuit
A simple circuit can be built using a battery, wires, and a bulb
Circuit diagrams use symbols for parts such as battery, bulb, and wire
Conductors are materials that allow electricity to flow through them
Insulators are materials that do not allow electricity to flow through them
Metals such as copper wire, paper clips, and coins are common conductors
Materials such as plastic, rubber, string, and erasers are common insulators
Testing different materials in a circuit can identify conductors and insulators
A switch can open or close a circuit to control electric current
Safety measures are important when working with electricity
